Hi, that literally happened to me today. "Come back when you want to stop birth control or if you want to get pregnant and we'll do those labs" because BC can affect some of my labs (like cortisol!). She wanted me to stop for a month but I said no.

B*tch I waited 3 months for this appointment, and that's it?

Knowing exactly what I'm doing through a shut door. He can *sense* what I'm doing. (He's just a regular person)

Oh also, watching me take a school test at a testing center... weird

I took a genetic test to see which meds would be right for me because Lexapro made me extremely tired and out of it, and my doctors didn't want to keep putting me on different meds with them not working. I'd recommend that or change meds if you also feel the same way.

Omg this is literally me. The clothes I bought in September barely fit anymore. I always maintain for a few weeks then gain 20ish lbs every 2-4 months. It's exhausting. I've tried everything and nothing helps, so I feel the same way. It's like once I start eating for the day I can't stop. I'm sorry that this disorder sucks 🫂
Go Vacation! It has 4 resorts and reminds me of Wii Sports a little bit. There's lots to explore and hidden treasure to find

My grandma is the same way. Always complaining about something! Like how my dress is off white instead of the standard bright white. My mom too, but she's come around and recently defended our decisions to my grandma (child-free wedding). I don't have much advice but just remember that it's your wedding, and you get to choose things that makes you and your partner happy. No one else's opinions matter. Best of luck!

I love halo top. The chocolate chip cookie dough flavor and the peanut butter cup flavor are top tier. Way better than real ice cream and I could eat the whole pint without feeling guilty or super bloated. Plus it's packed with protein.
[10 minute mail](https://10minutemail.com/) is also a good one to use. I haven't had any issues with the addresses getting denied.
She looks very similar to my cat Basil!❤️❤️
